discrepancies.live_says: Spring-MVC 404 'No static resource' — path entirely absent from live API router
discrepancies.note: Archive functionality exists on live Clockify but is handled via the main PUT /clients/{clientId} with {archived:true} in the body, not a dedicated /archive sub-path. Our spec documents a separate /archive path that does not exist on live.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  operationId: archiveClient
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-040000-put.workspaces.clients.archive-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    Spring-MVC 404 'No static resource v1/.../clients/{clientId}/archive' confirms
    the /archive sub-path is absent from live Clockify router. Archive semantics are
    available via the main PUT /clients/{clientId} endpoint with {archived:true} in
    the request body (covered by clockify_clients_update). Our spec documents this as
    a separate sub-path but live evidence contradicts. Official spec does not include
    this path. LIVE-OVERRIDE for the /archive sub-path.
  x-truth-iter: iter20
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: clientId
      in: path
      required: true
  responses:
    '404':
      description: Path absent on live API (use PUT /clients/{clientId} with archived:true body field)
endpoints.notes: Spring-MVC 'No static resource' on GET confirms /archive sub-path absent. Archive via body field on main client PUT endpoint (clockify_clients_update) instead. Our-spec-only path.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  operationId: updateCustomField
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-040000-put.workspaces.custom-fields-happy-path.json
    - PROBE-LOG/20260520-210956-get.workspaces.custom-fields-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    clockify_custom_fields_update successfully PUT to
    /workspaces/{wId}/custom-fields/{customFieldId} and received 200 with the
    updated custom field object. Idempotent update (same name+type+status as
    existing values) — no data changed. GET probe on /{customFieldId} first
    confirmed 405 (path registered, GET not supported). Both specs document
    this endpoint. MCP tool requires type on update (Clockify API constraint).
    Response shape: id, name, type, status, entityType, allowedValues,
    description, onlyAdminCanEdit, placeholder, projectDefaultValues,
    required, workspaceDefaultValue, workspaceId.
  x-truth-iter: iter20
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: customFieldId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [name, type]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              maxLength: 150
            type:
              type: string
              enum: [TXT, NUMBER, DROPDOWN_SINGLE, DROPDOWN_MULTIPLE, CHECKBOX, LINK]
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [VISIBLE, INVISIBLE, INACTIVE]
            required:
              type: boolean
            allowedValues:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            workspaceDefaultValue:
              description: Type-dependent default value
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Custom field updated
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
              name:
                type: string
              type:
                type: string
              status:
                type: string
              entityType:
                type: string
              allowedValues:
                type: array
              description:
                nullable: true
                type: string
              onlyAdminCanEdit:
                type: boolean
              placeholder:
                nullable: true
                type: string
              projectDefaultValues:
                type: array
              required:
                type: boolean
              workspaceDefaultValue:
                nullable: true
              workspaceId:
                type: string
endpoints.notes: Full LIVE-VERIFIED: PUT returned 200 with custom field object. Idempotent update — no data changed. Both specs agree on endpoint. GET on /{customFieldId} returns 405 (path registered, single-item GET not supported, list GET is on /custom-fields without ID).

      description: Expense updated
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
              billable:
                type: boolean

                type: string
              date:
                type: string
              fileId:
                type: string
              has_file:
                type: boolean

                type: boolean
